walkthrough_label: STACKED CASE S1-B - anticoagulated AF with iron-deficiency anaemia and an anticoagulant taken this morning
reason_answer: To have my gallbladder taken out.

presentation.summary: Mr George Mensah, 69, is booked for keyhole gallbladder removal. Known atrial fibrillation on a blood thinner that should have been stopped. He is pale and tired; Hb 104, MCV 74, ferritin 9.

history.answer: Pain under the right ribs after meals, and I have been so tired for three months.
My stools have been darker for some weeks. No chest pain, no breathlessness at rest.
Atrial fibrillation, high blood pressure, early kidney disease (stage G3a).
Apixaban, bisoprolol, amlodipine. I took my apixaban at seven this morning as I always do.
No anaesthetic problems in the family.

problems.label: Blood thinner taken this morning although the plan was to stop it two days before
problems.why: Bleeding risk at surgery; the anaesthetist and surgeon decide timing. The PAUSE plan (stop 2 days before for a moderate-bleeding-risk operation, no bridging) was not followed.
expected_actions: Confirm exactly when the last dose was taken
Tell the anaesthetist and the surgeon
Re-plan the list with a proper stop time
Do not stop or restart on your own

problems.label: Iron-deficiency anaemia in an older man on a blood thinner (darker stools): a bleeding source must be looked for
problems.why: WHO 2024: anaemia is below 130 in men. Unexplained iron deficiency is a red flag for gut bleeding.
expected_actions: Iron studies and group and save
Refer for investigation of the cause

problems.label: Known atrial fibrillation, rate controlled
problems.why: Confirm with an ECG that it is the known rhythm.

decisions.prompt: He took his blood thinner at seven this morning. What now?

options.text: Tell the anaesthetist and surgeon; the list cannot simply continue; plan a proper stop time
Say nothing as the surgery is only keyhole

decisions.prompt: Hb 104, MCV 74, ferritin 9 and darker stools. What now?

options.text: Moderate iron-deficiency anaemia: group and save, iron studies, refer to find the source; tell the senior
Treat it as chronic kidney disease only
options.consequence: A bleeding source could be missed.
